brief.headline: Push laminate price down from ₹385.00/KG to ₹250.00/KG — you already pay Silk Polypack that rate, and the open market confirms it's fair.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹250.00/KG on laminates (the LAMINATE SKU), matching Silk Polypack.
priceAsk.basis: You pay Silk Polypack ₹250.00/KG today; UFLEX charges ₹385.00/KG, a 54.0% gap. The open-market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate runs ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg), so your Silk price sits at the top of the fair band — UFLEX's ₹385 is well above market.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay in 30 days (instead of 60) in return for part of the price cut.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 30 days earlier frees up ₹5325 of our cash, so trade some of that saving for a steeper discount from them.

brief.financialLeverage: UFLEX is huge — ₹16492.00 Cr in sales — so your ₹64788 spend is 0.00% of their business; you have almost no pull on your own. They're growing fast (35.5% a year), hungry for volume, so they want your orders. They owe a lot — 1.25x their own cash — which means they value getting paid quickly. Put those together: you're tiny, but bundle a longer commitment or more volume, play them against Huhtamaki or Constantia, and offer faster payment to win a meaningful price cut.

evidence.point: UFLEX charges ₹385.00/KG; Silk Polypack charges ₹250.00/KG for the same laminate
Open-market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, typically ₹250/kg
Closing the gap to Silk's price saves us every year
You're a tiny customer — your spend rounds to zero of their revenue
They're growing fast and want new orders
They owe a lot relative to their own cash, so cash matters to them

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed converter, already supplies FDC in small volume, does pharma laminate sachets at scale — a proven second source (health score C 59/100, ₹2758.00 Cr revenue).

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Part of the global Constantia group, specializes in pharma blister and sachet laminates — strong backup for laminate supply (₹222.04 Cr revenue, health D 31/100).

risks: You're 0.00% of their sales — on your own you have no leverage; you must bundle more volume, commit longer, or credibly show you'll move orders to Huhtamaki or Constantia.
UFLEX owes 1.25x their equity in debt — not a red flag today, but watch delivery consistency; any hiccup and you need the second source ready.
The ₹250/kg target sits at the high end of the fair market band (₹205–305/kg) — if they refuse, ask them to show their cost build-up and justify the ₹385 rate.
Paying 30 days early frees ₹5325 of our cash — only trade that for a discount bigger than the cash cost to us.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We pay Silk Polypack ₹250 a kilo for the same laminate you charge us ₹385 for — the open market confirms ₹250 is fair, so let's close that gap.
